name: kiki-everything
description: Find local files and folders through the Everything index by name, path, extension, size and modification time.

interface.shortDescription: Fast indexed file and folder search on Windows

esPath.title: Official ES executable
esPath.description: Optional absolute path to voidtools es.exe >=1.1.0.37. Empty searches PATH, then the current user's WinGet installation.

instance.title: Everything instance
instance.description: Empty uses the default instance. Set only for a named instance, such as 1.5a. An unavailable instance fails instead of switching indexes.

timeoutMs.title: Search wait limit (milliseconds)
timeoutMs.description: Integer 100–120000, default 30000, including process-slot queue time. Cancellation or timeout stops only this call's ES process; other searches continue. Everything may finish its internal query after ES closes.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the local Windows Everything 1.5 index by file/directory name, path, extension, size or modification time. Pass root=C:/ (or another admitted drive/directory) for disk-wide search. Query terms are ANDed; quote phrases. Supports ext:pdf, size:>1gb and dm:today. Returns metadata only after Kiki path admission and sensitive/VCS filtering. Keep Glob for repository glob patterns and Grep for file contents. Index pages precede filtering; total is unknown. No HTTP or Python needed.

root.description: Directory/drive root to search, workspace-relative or absolute. Kiki approves external paths. Search each drive separately (e.g. C:/, D:/).

query.description: Everything indexed search syntax; spaces mean AND. Examples: report ext:pdf; "annual report"; size:>1gb; dm:today. No content/property-reading functions.

offset.description: Raw index offset BEFORE path/sensitive filtering. Continue with pagination.next_offset, even if a filtered page is empty.
